answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the delta of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The umber lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the whisper is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
